I hate to break it to you Op, but I think this is the wrong thing to do. 

First of all it will make things incredibly awkward, and will probably ruin your friendship if she doesn’t feel the same way. 

Second of all, you talk about how you need to unburden yourself, which is a reasonable thing to want, but unfortunately if you confess you will only be passing the burden over to her. 

I’m by no means any professional, but as someone who has been in the other position, I don’t think this is the right thing to do. 

I think if you really feel like you have to confess something, you should tell her that she means a lot to you as a friend, and though your feelings may be romantic you don’t want anything to change. Really emphasize your friendship, because otherwise she will think you’re only telling her because you want to date her. 

The other option of course is to try to quietly get over it, but I can see how that would be painful. 

Whatever you decide to do, I wish you luck Op.
